batting.name: DW Steyn
batting.dismissal: c MEK Hussey b Joginder Sharma

balls.text: bowls another slower one and he pulls and the ball lands down Dravid's throat at deep midwicket
the slower ball, he makes room  but fails to get the timing right as he scoops it to Chipli at deep extra cover
take that! Zaheer overcompensates by bowling a low full toss and he clubs that across the line and beats long-on
he tries out another slower ball but he pitches it on a good length, that's dangerous as Dhoni clubs that high over deep midwicket
lands on a good length and Dhoni gets on top of the bounce early and clubs that to the vacant deep square leg region
foxes him with a slower  ball, Dhoni eyes the long-on boundary buy he heaves and misses
full on middle and leg, he creams this straight to long-on, that's 24 off the over!
and now we have a misfield! Dhoni drives that firmly down to Chipli at long-off but he mistimes his dive and the ball slips past him
pitches this one a lot fuller and Dhoni drags that from outside off and beats deep midwicket, the timing wasn't the best but it was the power which sent the ball scorching
the carnage gets worse for Steyn as he stays back to a pitched up delivery and slogs it across the line over deep midwicket, that was brute power
fires in a screeching full toss and Dhoni swings and gets a thick outside edge which races down to third man
Bang! Steyn pitches it up and Dhoni stays at the crease and clubs it over his head, that sends the ball scorching down to the boundary
now this is certainly a wide, he slides down lwg
bowls off a much shorter run-up, Hussey attempts the reverse sweep but the slower ball foxes him, he waits for a wide call but that can't happen
slides on the pads, he tucks that to midwicket
overpitches on middle stump and Dhoni moves his front leg away and clubs it past the bowler and beats long-off, all power
bowls a low full toss from round the wicket and he chips it high over midwicket, Zaheer picks it up on the first bounce
pitches outside off and he swings across the line and places it to deep midwicket
lands on a fullish length on the pads and he whips that to Kohli at deep square leg
take that! The ball it pitched up outside off and Dhoni scoops it through the line and the ball nearly lands on the second tier over long-off

ouch! Hussey clubs it hard and straight and the ball strikes umpire Doctrove hard on the shoulder as he takes evasive action, the umpire saves a boundary and Hussey sees the funny side to it and they share a light moment and embrace, one for the album there
Hussey makes room and gets a thin under edge which trickles past the stumps and beats the keeper
good comeback by Kallis as he slips in a low full toss and Hussey only chips it back to the bowler
well done Huss! Kallis delivers a high full toss outside off and Hussey walks across and gently paddles it down to the vacant fine leg region
bowls it full and slow outside off, he walks across his stumps and tries to whip it behind square on the on side but gets an under edge
clubs it hard down the pitch and Akhil does brilliantly to intercept that as he falls over
sees him giving the charge and intelligently slips in the quick yorker, Dhoni has to settle for a single to long-on
jams in the yorker length outside off and he pushes it through the line to long-off
the slower ball, well disguised as Hussey swings and misses
he holds the length back this time but it doesn't help as he stays back and clubs him a few more rows back over deep midwicket
Akhil feeds him a well pitched up delivery on middle and leg and he gets on his knee and slogs him over midwicket
slightly slower in pace, he goes for the slog over midwicket and the ball appears to clip his thigh before reaching Boucher, he appeals for a caught behind, Doctrove shakes his head
has a wild swing outside off and he misses
shot! That was full on the pads and Dhoni gets his wrists working and clubs that past midwicket, all timing
slides down the leg side, Dhoni pulls but doesn't place it where he intended but he gets a thin inside edge and the ball rockets to fine leg
faster now, 145 kph, Dhoni throws the kitchen sink at it outside off but meets thin air
Once again Dhoni goes for the pull but he misreads the slower ball, the ball just makes contact with his pad
pulls this hard and the ball rolls along the turf down towards long leg and Steyn runs across and intercepts it with his boot
grants him width outside off, he gets a thick outside edge down to third man, Steyn fumbles and they steal an extra run
the slower ball, he gets forward and steers past cover, he plays that with an angled bat, Taylor's throw hits Hussey
shapes to pull but the shot doesn't come off as he gets a thick edge onto his pads
Dhoni shapes to bludgeon that straight by walking across his stumps but Kallis holds the length back outside off and beats him
full and swinging in, he pushes it down to long-on
stays back and thuds that really hard down the pitch, they think of a single but Kallis runs forward and intercepts it
stays back at the crease and whips it behind square on the on side
slides on the pads, he tucks it to the on side
gets back and chops it down to the offside

sloppy running! He pushes it to the on side and they attempt an extra run  on the midfield at mid-on, Hussey isnt interested and he sends Raina back, he turns around but Boucher whips the bails off and Raina's well short
fires in the yorker, he makes room and digs it out to the offside
shot man! Praveen digs it fractionally short of a length, he waits on it gets on top of the bounce and clubs it a few rows over deep midwicket
fires in the yorker, that really swings in sharply and he manages to dig it out to the offside
gets across his stumps, checks the on drive and nearly chips it on the full to the bowler
gives him the charge but he gets an under edge to the on side, we've seen quite a few mis-hits today
bangs in the slow bouncer, he goes for the pull rather early and the bounce is loopy before reaching Boucher
stays back at the crease and chops it down towards cover
gets back and pushes this to the on side
short outside off, he carves it high over backward point, Jaffer makes a mess of it at the boundary and deflects the ball past the rope
slides on the pads, he whips that to the on side
tries to steer that down to third man, the extra bounce takes him by surprise
bangs that on middle and gets plenty of away movement, close to being called a wide
taps it very softly and the ball nearly rolls onto the stumps, Raina's very quick off the blocks and they take a quick single
shuffles at the crease and whips this down to midwicket
gets back and punches this in front of cover
bowls him a real snorter, Raina shapes to pull but the pace catches him by surprise, he luckily checks the stroke and the top edge falls safely in front of kallis
the slower ball, he opens the face and steers it to third man
Raina tears him apart with a straight six, the ball lands on a good length and he makes room and clubs that many rows back
pitches on a good length, he rocks back and punches to the offside
the slower ball, he waits on it and glides it down to third man
gets on the backfoot and punches that to the offside
takes the aerial route again and he carves this over extra cover this time, just falls short of the fielder
lands that on a fullish length on middle and leg, he scoops it over midwicket and Praveen runs across at the deep to pick it up
gets a thick inside edge and that nearly rolls onto the stumps
a big mishit, Hussey tries to pull and gets a thick top edge, Dravid runs backwards from slip and tries to pull it off one handed but the ball just beats him
scooped past cover, there's protection in the deep
this one kicks up on Suresh Raina, he tries to carve that over the covers but he checks his stroke and keeps it along the ground and beats cover
turns it in front of mid-on and sets off very quickly
hits a good length on middle and he hops and tucks it to fine leg
ends the over with a dot ball, pitches on a good length and forces him on the backfoot
pitches outside off and comes on straight, he punches that off the meat of the bat to cover
pitches outside off, he punches that to the offside
Praveen gives him a bit of width outside off, Patel attempts a cheeky glide down to third man but ends up edging to Kallis at first slip who slides to his left and catches it
bangs in another short one and Patel hooks and the ball sails high and just clears the rope at fine leg, he was well in control of that
bangs in the bouncer, Patel arches under it
133 kph, he slides on the pads again and he glances it down to fine leg
false shot from Patel as he mistimes a scoop and nearly gives mid-on a catch
slides on middle and leg and Patel whips it away very firmly past square leg, the ball rocketed off the bat
holds the length back on middle and off, it comes on quicker as he tries to flicks that, the ball rolls to the on side
slides on the pads this time and Hussey works it with the swing and glances it down to fine leg
133 kph, Zaheer gets that to balloon up just short of a length and the bounce has Patel by surprise as he fends that in front of cover
works it towards square leg and Chipli does well to restrict that to a single
pitches fractionally wide outside off and he steers it down to third man
grants him width outside off, he uppishly scoops it past the vacant gully region and down to third man
pitches on off and middle, he pushes it towards midwicket
Hussey walks down the pitch to clubs that over the on side but Praveen holds the length back and Hussey misses
Praveen lands that ona good length outside off, Patel taps it to the offside

Zaheer gets his man this time! lands that on the same full length outside off from round the wicket, Hayden makes room to swing it over the on side but gets a thick edge and the ball rolls onto the stumps
Zaheer goes round the wicket, Hayden makes room and gets a thin inside edge which just misses the stumps, very streaky, Hayden's now the leading run scorer  of the IPL
full outside off and Hayden creams it straight to mid-off, the placement isnt coming off well today
false shot, he sees the width outside off and has a wild swish at it
full again and it was in the slot to drive, Hayden pushes that firmly but finds mid-on
Hayden tries to improvise by walking across his stumps but the ball was a little too full to slam it back past the bowler, Zaheer picks it up
slides towards the pads again and he closes the face of the bat and takes a single towards midwicket
shapes to push that past the bowler but gets an inside edge down towards fine leg, Zaheer runs across and cuts it off
strays wide down the leg side this time and Hayden nearly clips it through with his pads
fires that at 143 kph, he really pounds it on the pitch and forces Hayden to weave away to take evasive action
the slower ball, however he misdirects it slightly wide outside the offstump, harsh call
raw pace, 144 kph, lands it a little wide outside off and gets appreciable bounce as Boucher takes it high
gets this to come back in, he turns the face of the bat and clips it to mid-on
hits a good length on middle, he shuffles and tucks it through the line to fine leg
Zaheer slides that on the pads and he works it on its way down to fine leg, gets a bit of swing there
walks a few paces down and shapes to club it past the bowler but he mistimes it to mid-on, takes a quick single
Hayden latches onto a short of a length ball outside off, moves across and pulls with intent over midwicket
makes Hayden play by getting it to nip back in, he shapes to defend but gets a leading edge in front of cover
lands it much fuller and Patel nearly loses his wicket as the inside edge nearly shaves the stumps
what bounce! Zaheer lands it outside off, kicks up on Patel and slices him in half, how did that not take the edge?
140 kph, this one lands on the exact same spot and rears up, cramps Hayden for any room and he shoulders arms again
even quicker, 144 kph, this one lands on the corridor outside off and kicks up on Hayden  who wisely shoulders arms
fires that at 141 kph, lands a little wide outside off and carries through to Boucher near his face
lands on middle and comes back in, he taps it to mid-off
fires that at 142 kph, pitches outside off, seams back in and beats Hayden, the crowd gets animated
immediately strays on the pads and gets it to swing in, Patel whips it to fine leg

that's four in four for the Superkings! Steyn scoops a low full toss high down to Hussey at long-on who dives forward and takes it low. All in the dugout rush onto the field and they gather for a huddle
he gets on his knee and tries to paddle scoop that over fine-leg, the ball catches him flush on the pads
he swings but can't put away a yorker, deep square leg does the fielding
he fails to put away a full toss and ends up placing it to midwicket

It gets worse for Bangalore here! Akhil clubs a low full toss down to long-on, he settles for a single but Praveen thinks otherwise as he charges down for the second, Akhil and him are both in the same end, quite a farcial dismissal
makes room and pushes that wide of mid-off, Raina gathers the ball and throws it flat and hard to Dhoni, Zaheer is struggling to make his ground
Oram fires that on the blockhole outside off and he makes room to slice it through the offside but misses
that's a low full toss and he makes room and carves it over gully and wide of third man
fires that on the blockhole and he gets a thick edge onto his boot
Zaheer makes room and carves a full delivery and the ball goes on the first bounce to sweeper cover
full again, he makes room and crashes this straight to the sweeper on the offside
full outside off, he pushes this one down to deep point
Praveen stays back and punches it hard to long-off
pitches on middle and leg, he tucks it to the on side
cartwheel! Morkel fires in an inswinging yorker, Kohli tries to swing across the line but is beaten for pace and the legstump goes for a toss and falls back by a few yards
makes room but mistimes it to the offside, Praveen is frustrated with that shot
he overpitches outside off and Kohli makes room and carves that down to the deep point boundary, that should ease the pressure
punches this one hard down to deep extra cover
Gony gets one to angle inwards from off stump, Dravid shapes to flick but the ball strikes him in line of middle and leg, Tiffen thinks about it for ages before raising the finger
he makes room and creams a full delivery to long-off
he gets him this time! Boucher gets another thick top edge off a good length delivery and lobs it high to Hussey at third man who takes it inches off the rope
Dropped: Boucher gets a thick leading edge as he tries to work that to the on side, Raina runs backwards from cover but spills the skier in the region of mid-off
Amarnath errs by pitching that on leg stump and he easily flicks that well wide of Oram at short fine-leg
fires that in with more pace and digs it in shorter, Kohli is beaten for pace as he swings and misses
bangs it in short outside off, he dabs it to third man and a misfield by Joginder allows an extra run
Boucher lofts this one over mid-off and checks his stroke as the ball lands well short of the fielder
bowls a fullish delivery on the pads and he flicks it to short fine-leg
now does that turn things around! Amarnath pitches it up outside off and Taylor chips it on the up and finds Raina at cover who takes a sharp catch
Joginder ends a good over by beating Boucher outside the off stump, he shapes to cut but misses
fullish outside off, he steers it down to sweeper cover
that was harsh, Taylor shuffles across and misses a wide delivery, Tiffen signals a wide
lands on a yorker length and he angles it down towards third man, the ball travels quickly to third man bur Hussey cuts off the boundary with a brilliant slide
fuller outside off, he angles it down to third man
a short delivery really climbs on Boucher and he nearly feathers it to the keeper as he tries to upper cut it
he shuffles across his stumps and Joginder follows him by bowling it wide outside off, Kallis gets a thin edge to Dhoni and Joginder knows he's got him, he doesn't turn back for the confirmation
the slower ball deceives him again as he slogs and meets thin air
fullish and wide outside off, he slices that on the up to Joginder who runs across from fine leg to cutr it off
pushes a full delivery down to long-off and brings up his fifty
Taylor gets forward and clubs a pitched up delivery high over long-on, the power sent that a dozen rows back
that ball shoots through really low and beats him, we've never seen that before today
Taylor tries to heave that over the on side but the slower ball deceives him
full outside off and pushed to long-off
Kallis walks down the pitch, swivels and pulls a short delivery rather unusually down to deep square leg, his bat twirled on the follow through
slightly wide outside off, he gets forward and plays a square drive to Gony at sweeper cover
hits a good length on middle and leg, he turns his wrists and clips it to deep midwicket
that's fractionally short and Kallis rocks back and punches it firmly past extra cover, Gony dives in vain
fires in a bouncer, he takes evasive action
shuffles across his stumps and easily glances this one down to fine leg
pitches on middle and off, he gets across and works it past midwicket
shuffles across and angles it wide of point to give Taylor the strike
comes forward and pushes a full delivery through the line to long-on
shuffles across his stumps and tucks it wide of square leg
Kallis shuffles across and deftly glances it wide of short fine leg, Joginder feeds it on the pads
Amarnath pitches it up outside off, Jaffer walks down and tries to cart that over long-off but Oram dives forward and takes the catch
brilliant improvisation by Jaffer as he shuffles premeditatedly and paddles it wide of the keeper to bring up his fifty
shapes to slog that over square leg  but he mistimes it and gets a thick under edge onto his pads
dot ball..that's a rarity, Amarnath cramps him for room and Taylor only manages to tap it back to the bowler

brilliant fielding! Jaffer steers it down towards third man and times that sweetly, Hussey runs across, pushes it away and the ball nearly rolls towards the ropes again on the deflection, Gony eventually picks it up
the slower ball, lands outside off, he steers it wide of point
attempts a yorker, he shuffles and works it to deep square leg
turns the face of the bat and glances it wide of square leg
tries the slow bouncer, he reads it a little late and flicks it straight to Oram at short fine leg
slides on middle and leg, he tucks it with the line wide of midwicket
what timing! Jaffer takes a couple of paces down and elegantly flicks a good length ball and clears deep square leg
Taylor shuffles and flicks one behind square but can't beat Oram at short fine leg
Jaffer responds by staying back at the crease and pulling a short delivery over deep square leg, Jaffer's like an underdog when it comes to big hits and the crowd love it when he pulls it off
shuffles across his stumps early to try and whip it past short fine leg but misses
backs away a little and chops it down wide of point
slides on the pads, he turns his wrists and glances it wide of short fine leg who makes a despairing dive
makes room to crash it through the off side but he mistimes it to mid-off
hits a good length outside off, he punches to short cover
slides wide down the leg side
moves across his stumps early and glances that one down to fine leg
fullish outside off, he plays with an angled bat and scoops it over backward point
Amarnath digs on in short and gets it to climb on the batsman, he fends it off his gloves to the on side
strays on the pads again, he clips it past square leg but there's protection in the deep
slides on the pads, he clips it wide of midwicket
Dropped: That's two for the night for Gony! Taylor scoops it over mid-on, Gony over runs the ball and completely misjudges it, the ball lobs off him and rolls to the boundary
Jaffer gives him the charge but Morkel digs it in short, he adjusts his stroke by tapping it wide of short third man
short and wide down the leg side, he swings and misses
fullish outside off, he drives through the line to the sweeper cover
Taylor moves across his stumps and puts away a half volley by turning his wrists and timing it crisply past midwicket, Joginder can't get to it
slides wide down the leg side, Morkel loses his line
bangs one in short and he hops and fends it off to the on side, they set off quickly for the single
gets across his stumps and pushes this one wide of mid-on
starts off with a full delivery, Jaffer takes a few paces down and drives crisply but can't beat a diving Joginder at mid-on
brute force! Gony overpitches and Taylor gets across and clubs that off the meat of the bat over deep midwicket, the ball just rocketed off the bat, phew!
Taylor goes for a massive slog on the front foot but the ball is too short for that, that kicked up at good pace too
short of a length outside off and seams away, he opens the face of the bat and steers it to third man
the slower ball, that was a gift really as he pitches it too short and allows Jaffer to get on top of the bounce and carve it over cover
makes room but the extra pace forces him to adjust his stroke, he ends up chopping the ball down
Jaffer gives him the charge and plays an elegant scoop over his head, Amarnath runs backwards and pulls it back
half volley outside off and Taylor makes him pay by creaming that into the arc between mid-off and cover
beats him with a slow yorker, good deception
Dropped: Taylor gets a thick edge off the toe of his bat and Dhoni and Patel at slip have a go at it, the ball lobs off Dhoni's glove, they share a laugh after that drop
bowls a yorker, he digs it out to midwicket
clubbed! That is pitched up around the offstump and Taylor gets across and heaves this one high over deep midwicket, the ball lands high over the second tier
Taylor shapes to drive straight but closes the face of the bat and mistimes it back to the bowler
Dropped: Gony gets a sitter of a return catch but he fails to hang onto it, Jaffer in fact checked his stroke
this time he makes room to scoop this over mid-off but he misses
my goodness! Gony pitches this on leg stump and he nonchalantly flicks this high down to fine leg, the ball just lands short of the rope, elegance there
stays back and punches it hard down the pitch and just beats the bowler
slides on the pads, he whips it across the line on the front foot
timber! Gony bowls that on a good length and the line is dead straight, Chipli makes room to cart that over the bowler's head but the ball shoots off the pitch and hits the top of middle stump
tries to dispatch this one by making room but it fails to come off as he only manages an inside edge to midwicket
defended solidly back to the bowler, such shots won't take them home
pitches outside off and cramps him for room as he defends back to the bowler, the crowd start booing
squares Jaffer up with a jaffa! very appropriate, he pokes his bat out and nearly gets an edge
we've seen about a 100 inside edges already today and here's one more, this one trickles to fine leg
tests him out with a lifter outside off and the extra bounce beats the drive, good delivery
hits the deck hard outside off, he adjusts himself on the backfoot and punches this wide of point
pitches on middle and leg, he softly pushes it to mid-on
brilliantly played, it lands just fractionally wide outside off and Chipli stays back and punches that off the meat of the bat and beats cover
well bowled, swings late and lands on a yorker length, he digs it out to mid-on
hits the deck hard outside off and the ball rears on the batsman and beats him
bowls that full on the pads and he chips it away and Morkel does brilliantly to slide to his right at mid-on and cut it off
short of a length delivery angling into middle stump, flicked through midwicket
fuller length on middle stump, driven off the front foot between mid-on and midwicket for a single
short and wide outside off stump, Jaffer throws his bat at it but can't reach it, wide called
good length delivery cuts into the right-hander from off stump, defended on the front foot towards the off side
played off the pads towards long leg for a single
good length delivery outside off stump, left alone by the batsman
full ball strays down leg side, wide called
short of a length ball on middle and leg stump, Jaffer puses off his pads towards midwicket
